title: WRECK (the player's rocket, crashed and broken in two)
height: outdoor: no walls; the aft section's raised leg stands 6.3 m up, the work lamp 0.35 m
items: AFT SECTION on its side (engine bell, tanks, legs; 10.3 m long, 4.0 m across)
FORWARD SECTION (crew capsule and nose, 25 degrees off line, hatch open to the sky)
THE BREAK (torn skin, cables across the 1.2 m gap, the work lamp burning)
LANDING LEG torn off: strut and footpad (2.4 m)
PROBE LANDER standing where it was thrown (2.1 x 2.1 m)
ROOM TO STAND round the wake spot: keep clear

lamps.name: break lamp
lamps.why: concept C2: the work lamp still burning in the break; its 9 m reach the old plan's, its colour and energy unverified seed numbers until the light stage's sweep

decals.name: scorch
decals.element: burn in the ground round the break
decals.why: the old plan's burn (E5): 11 m reach round the break, solid to 3.9 m; its 13 rays and seed unverified seed numbers

concept.read: concept C2 read element by element (2026-10-12), each mapped to the inventory's rows, a decal or dropped with its reason; the old plan's locked elements (moonground2/wreck/plan.json E1-E17) and pieces P1-P16 give the metres

notes: Frame: the wreck's seat (x across, z along, +z towards the base 55 m off); the site is the old plan's, x -14 to 14 and z -16 to 13.

Layout: the coordinator's decision of 2026-10-08 (owner may change), following C2: the rocket broken in two on the ground, the aft section re-laid on its side, the forward section resting in a 2.5 m dent 30 cm deep where it struck, the two pressure spheres in shallow dents (the Moon ground plan's dents).

The supply rocket, the cargo lift and the landing dust are not in C2 and stand nowhere here (decision 2026-10-12: follow the concept); the owner's rejection of the landing pad and the old ship stands.
